rules.id: CAT-3 needs a trainer on the bench
rules.name: CAT-3 needs a trainer on the bench
rules.plainEnglish: Any day CAT-3 is staffed, at least one person on it must be a trainer.

rules.id: Reference lab reports need a Senior BMS
rules.name: Reference lab reports need a Senior BMS
rules.plainEnglish: Reporting Ref Lab Reports must have at least 1 Senior BMS on it.

rules.id: Keep Marcus Kell and Sarah Patel apart
rules.name: Keep Marcus Kell and Sarah Patel apart
rules.plainEnglish: Marcus Kell and Sarah Patel are never on the same bench on the same day.

rules.name: No trainees on CSF
rules.plainEnglish: Anyone at Trainee grade cannot be assigned to CSF.

rules.id: Hannah Ng holds one bench all week
rules.name: Hannah Ng holds one bench all week
rules.plainEnglish: Hannah Ng should stay on the same bench every day this week.

rules.id: Cap Urines at three days a week
rules.name: Cap Urines at three days a week
rules.plainEnglish: Nobody should be on Urines more than 3 days in the week.

rules.id: At most one trainee on Urines
rules.name: At most one trainee on Urines
rules.plainEnglish: Urines should have at most 1 person at Trainee grade on it.
